title: gtools liberator: brew-only, private ssh tap, per hv's dev/opt/brew ruling for Gtools
body:
## Ask

hv ruled (25 Oct 2026, in gtools-vc's session, relayed to molt-vc at about 07:10Z) that Gtools joins devbin's dev/opt/brew contract in full. Molt's next release therefore adds a `gtools` liberator, as Molt has for intent, utilz and pplr.

- Formula: `gtools`, in the private tap `matthewsinclair/homebrew-gtools`, reached over ssh as devbin's tap is: `git@github.com:matthewsinclair/homebrew-gtools.git`.
- The tap exists only after Gtools' cut (Gtools ST0018), so the liberator's brew leg can be proven against the real tap only then. Until then the tests fake brew, as the intent and utilz bats do.

## Spec (vc, 25 Oct 2026)

`liberators/gtools.sh`, brew only, in the shape of `liberators/intent.sh`: `MOLT_GTOOLS_FORMULA="matthewsinclair/gtools/gtools"`; `gtools_check`, `gtools_install` and `gtools_verify` ask `molt_brew_faults "$MOLT_GTOOLS_FORMULA" gtools`, so the verdict names the gtools that PATH actually runs, and install goes through `molt_brew_install`. No checkout mode and no link of Molt's own. A sleeve that develops Gtools runs its dev or opt tree under the contract, never through this liberator.

**The private tap.** `brew install matthewsinclair/gtools/gtools` auto-taps over https, which a private repo refuses. When the tap is not yet tapped, install must first run `brew tap matthewsinclair/gtools git@github.com:matthewsinclair/homebrew-gtools.git`. Put this in one place: extend `molt_brew_install` (lib/molt.sh) with an optional tap URL, used only when the formula's tap is missing, rather than tapping inside gtools.sh. Nothing changes for intent and utilz, which pass none. A failed tap fails install with brew's words shown, never a silent skip. Check reports a missing tap as a fault that names the tap command.

**Wiring.** Register it the way pplr is: MODULES.md row, README liberator table row (platforms linux, macos), CHANGELOG Added line, and `docs/guides/writing-a-liberator.md`'s Homebrew-tap exception names gtools beside Intent and Utilz. Enable it on no sleeve's molt.toml yet: enabling it waits for the tap to exist, after Gtools' cut, and is hv's.

**Tests.** `test/liberators/gtools.bats` fakes brew as the intent and utilz bats do: not installed (check names `brew install`), tap missing (install taps over the ssh URL, then installs), tap failure (install fails, brew's reason shown), installed but another gtools first on PATH (check names it), healthy. Each new test must fail with the liberator reverted. Run the whole suite under Homebrew bash and /bin/bash 3.2, plus shellcheck on the touched files.

## Proof still owed after Gtools' cut

On a sleeve enabled by hv: `molt install gtools` taps over ssh and installs, then `molt doctor` reports Homebrew's gtools as what PATH runs. On kovacs, through kovacs-sysadm, if Gtools ships a Linux formula.

This proof stays open after the close: the fake-brew tests prove the liberator's logic, not the real tap. cc holds it on its board until Gtools is cut and hv enables a sleeve.

## As built (cc, 25 Oct 2026; merged and pushed by vc at 0d06d02)

- `liberators/gtools.sh`, brew only, in `intent.sh`'s shape: `MOLT_GTOOLS_FORMULA` and `MOLT_GTOOLS_TAP_URL`, with check, install and verify through `molt_brew_faults` and `molt_brew_install`.
- `lib/molt.sh`: `molt_brew_install` and `molt_brew_faults` take an optional tap URL, and a new `molt_brew_tapped` reads `brew tap`'s list. Install taps over ssh only when the formula and its tap are both missing; a failed tap fails install with brew's stderr shown and `brew tap ... failed`; check names `brew tap matthewsinclair/gtools <url>, then brew install ...`. intent and utilz pass no URL and are unchanged.
- `test/test_helper.bash`: the shared brew stub keeps a taps list, prints it for a bare `brew tap`, and fails a tap with a publickey error on `.tap-fails`.
- `test/liberators/gtools.bats`: healthy, not installed, tap missing (check), tap then install, no re-tap when tapped, tap failure, and another gtools first on PATH. Every test fails with the liberator removed, and the tap tests fail with only `lib/molt.sh` reverted.
- MODULES, README (table row and the never-install-packages line), CHANGELOG Unreleased Added, and `docs/guides/writing-a-liberator.md` name gtools.
- Enabled on no sleeve, and not in `templates/molt.toml.example`, which lists no intent entry either.
- The full suite passes under Homebrew bash 5.3.20 and /bin/bash 3.2.57, and shellcheck is clean on the touched code.
